upper_mass_policy: Preserve ChassisMassKg on the body and original UE welded yaw/pitch masses separately: 20 + 0.1 + 0.1 kg upper assembly; total vehicle 25.6 kg.
self_collision_policy: Exclude pairs of bodies belonging to this vehicle only; retain contact with other robots and the static world.
inertia_policy: Homogeneous source convex-assembly inertia, rescaled to current drive-profile part mass; not a hardware measurement.
notes: Current drive-profile.json owns drive and suspension constants.
Original UE visual meshes and materials remain unchanged.
All movement and contact in this backend are solved by MuJoCo; visual transform updates only reproduce its output.
Native body damping uses original UE rate coefficients as COM force and inertia-weighted torque; contact friction maps the observed UE Average material rule.

contact_mapping.vehicle_friction_source: drive-profile.json physics.WheelFriction/ChassisFriction converted to UE UPhysicalMaterial float
contact_mapping.effective_sliding_rule: arithmetic mean of source vehicle and source static material
contact_mapping.scope: one articulated vehicle; verified homogeneous RMUC2027 static contact materials
contact_mapping.solver_mapping: MuJoCo compliant contact remains solver-specific; no extra torsional or rolling coefficient

gravity_source.runtime_guard: Require active UWorld.GetGravityZ to match generated MuJoCo gravity before Reset or stepping.
gravity_source.scope: vehicle dynamics; TrainingRange.GravityCm is an independent projectile setting
